title: Compute a boundary-safe local parabolic symmetrizer by finite algebra
statement: For the reduced D(c) with positive-real-part spectrum, solve D^T P+P D=2I. The Lyapunov integral2 integral_0^infinity exp(-D^T r)exp(-D r)dr proves P symmetric positive definite; computation uses the finite Kronecker-sum linear system, not an integral/PDE oracle. P is rational in concentrations, smooth near the closed simplex and has computable compact coercivity bounds, unlike the singular logarithmic entropy Hessian at zeros. Standard normally parabolic theory then supplies the stated boundary-safe LOCAL strong framework. Differentiating composition-dependent P,D still creates uncontrolled gradient products; no global strong theorem follows.
